boundary: Exploratory historical-test-pool prompt comparison; B is with replacement, overlaps A, and is not an independent final test
budget: Two prompts x 1000 draws = 2000 response slots, no added candidates or prompt tuning; at most 3 HTTP attempts plus one 3-attempt transport-only recovery per slot
changed: Only add behavior instruction and visible-only summary to the same masked input
features: five most frequent visible signed lengths and counts
same-sign/sign-change counts for originally adjacent visible packets; skip pairs touching masks
invalid: retain all draws; invalid or failed responses fill masked slots with zero; no format repair
not_included: No timestamps/IAT: absent from frozen B payload; no hidden truth, class, flow or PCAP identity in API requests
primary: equal-weight mean accuracy of six frozen classifiers; also report mean macro-F1, magnitude/signed MAE, direction and exact hit rate

prompts.behavior: Impute missing packet lengths in a single bidirectional network flow. The input array is chronological. Positive and negative denote opposite directions, magnitude is IP length in bytes (clipped at 1600). Each null is one missing packet. Return JSON only: an object with key values containing one nonzero signed integer in [-1600,1600] per null, in left-to-right order. Preserve the number of missing slots. Use the signs and magnitudes on both sides of each gap, repeated signed lengths, and alternating or same-direction runs to resolve ambiguous slots. Summary fields list the most frequent signed lengths and counts, the number of visible packets of each sign, and observed adjacent same-sign and sign-changing pairs. Adjacency counts skip gaps.
prompts.plain: Impute missing packet lengths in a single bidirectional network flow. The input array is chronological. Positive and negative denote opposite directions, magnitude is IP length in bytes (clipped at 1600). Each null is one missing packet. Return JSON only: an object with key values containing one nonzero signed integer in [-1600,1600] per null, in left-to-right order. Preserve the number of missing slots.

report_subsets: 933 draws whose flows were absent from A
selection: Wait for completed A including transport recovery and all six-classifier scores; use its predeclared ranking
stopping: stop on fatal HTTP 400/401/403/404; otherwise finish both fixed variants then score once
